welcomeMessage.en: Today, we are talking all about careers and work culture.
welcomeMessage.zh: 今天，我们将讨论所有关于职业和工作文化的话题。

welcomeMessage.en: We'll discuss your first jobs, dream jobs, work-life balance, and maybe even a few terrible boss stories!
welcomeMessage.zh: 我们将讨论你的第一份工作、理想的工作、工作与生活的平衡，甚至可能还有一些关于糟糕老板的故事！

welcomeMessage.en: Get ready to share your professional experiences and ambitions!
welcomeMessage.zh: 准备好分享你的专业经验和抱负吧！

questionsToThinkAbout.en: What was your very first job? Did you enjoy it?
questionsToThinkAbout.zh: 你的第一份工作是什么？你喜欢它吗？

questionsToThinkAbout.en: If money was not an issue, what would be your absolute dream job?
questionsToThinkAbout.zh: 如果不用考虑钱的问题，你绝对理想的工作会是什么？

questionsToThinkAbout.en: How important is work-life balance to you? Do you often work overtime?
questionsToThinkAbout.zh: 工作与生活的平衡对你来说有多重要？你经常加班吗？

questionsToThinkAbout.en: Have you ever had a really great (or terrible) boss? What made them that way?
questionsToThinkAbout.zh: 你遇到过非常棒（或非常糟糕）的老板吗？是什么让他们变成那样？

questionsToThinkAbout.en: Do you prefer working from home or going into an office every day?
questionsToThinkAbout.zh: 你更喜欢在家工作还是每天去办公室？

vocabulary.definition: An occupation undertaken for a significant period of a person's life and with opportunities for progress.
vocabulary.example: She is pursuing a successful career in the medical field.

vocabulary.definition: The division of one's time and focus between working and family or leisure activities.
vocabulary.example: My new company offers a much better work-life balance.

vocabulary.definition: Time worked in addition to one's normal working hours.
vocabulary.example: He has been working a lot of overtime to finish the project.

vocabulary.definition: The ideal job that one hopes to have.
vocabulary.example: Getting paid to travel the world is my ultimate dream job.

vocabulary.definition: A person with whom one works in a profession or business.
vocabulary.example: My colleagues are very supportive and helpful.

vocabulary.definition: A person in charge of a worker or organization.
vocabulary.example: My manager asked me to prepare a presentation for tomorrow.

vocabulary.definition: A fixed regular payment made by an employer to an employee.
vocabulary.example: She accepted the job offer because the salary was very competitive.

vocabulary.definition: The action of raising someone to a higher position or rank.
vocabulary.example: After three years of hard work, he finally got a promotion.
